proposed.text: A partnership of four architects admits a non-architect investor who would own 30 percent. What must happen for RA 9266 compliance?

options.text: Nothing; the 75 percent rule applies only to corporations.
The structure must be corrected so RLAs compose at least 75 percent of the applicable ownership or membership.
The non-architect automatically becomes an RLA.

proposed.rationale: RA 9266 Section 37 requires registered and licensed architects to compose at least 75 percent of the listed ownership/control categories, as applicable.
